title: PodcastEpisode model
description: Create AggregatorApp/Models/PodcastEpisode.swift with a Codable, Identifiable struct matching the GET /podcasts API response shape. Use explicit CodingKeys for snake_case-to-camelCase mapping and decodeIfPresent for all optional fields (episodeTheme, durationSeconds, llmModel, ttsModel, ttsVoice, generatedAt). Follow the same explicit init(from decoder:) pattern as Brief.swift. Date fields are stored as String (never Date).
acceptance_criteria: PodcastEpisode decodes all required and optional fields from the documented JSON shape
Optional fields decode to nil when absent without throwing
Explicit CodingKeys map snake_case API names to camelCase Swift names
